name: reseassistenten
description: Connect ChatGPT or Codex to ReseAssistenten: read your trips, bookings, travel documents and travel-planning intelligence on your behalf, with exactly the permissions you have on the web.

interface.shortDescription: Read your trips, bookings and travel documents on your behalf.
interface.longDescription: A portable Agent Plugin for ReseAssistenten (https://reseassistenten.se). It declares the hosted, per-user-authenticated MCP server at https://reseassistenten.se/mcp as a remote Streamable-HTTP server. On first use your browser opens for OAuth login + consent on ReseAssistenten (dynamic client registration, discovered from the server) — no tokens or secrets are stored in this plugin. The agent acts with exactly the permissions you have on the web.
